newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down two cents at 14.27 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down two cents at 14.27 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell two cents to 14.27 ringgit ($5.76) a kg after sellers outnumbered buyers by a small margin following the closure of the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday, traders said.
"It was a very quiet morning with the LME's closure," said a Malaysian trader. "It was a case of more sellers than buyers."
There were 69 tonnes on offer, against bids for 57. Final turnover was 57 tonnes against 126 tonnes on Friday. Buyers were European, Japanese and locals.
A premium of $45 was maintained against London.
